<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Fearful Symmetry](/Feats.aspx?ID=5494) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Emotion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=590" />
<trait label="Fear" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=598" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
<trait label="Visual" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=727" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 77

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); weretiger

**Requirements**
You’re in hybrid or tiger shape and your last action was a critically successful Strike with your unarmed attack.

</column>

---

You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly. All enemies within 30 feet of the creature you critically hit must attempt at a Will save against your class DC. Enemies that fail their saves become [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) and are [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with you for 1 round. Your [hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) don't end this fascination, but those of your allies do. Regardless of the effects of the save, the creature is immune to Fearful Symmetry for 1 hour.
name: Fearful Symmetry
requirement: You’re in hybrid or tiger shape and your last action was a critically successful Strike with your unarmed attack.
